plan: A lunar assassin who dashes onto her target and pulls a whole team around her.
aSurveiller: Her R (Moonfall). She pulls in all nearby enemies then explodes: spread out when she dashes at you.
contrer: Spread out in fights: her R pulls in all nearby enemies.
Dodge her Q: if it marks you, she can dash at you twice.
Use your crowd control after her E: she has no escape left.
forces: Her R pulls in several enemies.
faiblesses: Relies on her Q to dash twice.

sorts.W: Three orbs around her and a shield.
sorts.E: Dashes to an enemy; no cooldown if marked.
sorts.R: Pulls in and slows nearby enemies.
